comments.body: Where drop this sword? in first land or next land?. anyone know what npc drop this?? thanks

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
The boss who drops this weapon is found at Rapa Nui Interior, the inland (or second) zone of Rapa Nui/Easter Island. To enter that area requires either having completed this quest, or being escorted in by another player who has:

Searching Hawaiki

The quest chain is actually pretty long; it's well worth it as that's an awesome place to visit, but requires a lot of long sailing trips through the Pacific Ocean, and Southeast Asia. However you get there, the weapon is then dropped somewhat rarely by the Coreya Lv56, an NPC boss found in the vicinity of a line of Moai statues, surrounded by Coreya Gang Lv41 henchmen.

Probably due to all of that, this weapon is rarely if ever seen in the game. If and when you do finally go hunting for it, I wish you well in your undertaking. Cheers.
